interface.longDescription: Health-first Promkes production compiler with mandatory M00/S14 conversation preflight, a summary-bounded context register, evidence contracts and fail-closed gates. Social distribution is optional; reach, FYP, virality and engagement are never promised. Private legacy CTRL engine remains separate from GitHub V4-CTL candidate pending independent review and controlled synchronization. Host, AI, Remotion runtime/render, media QA, rights, license and human approval require separate evidence.
defaultPrompt: Transform supplied Promkes poster/infographic, caption, audio/transcript, script or hybrid materials into a traceable explainer production package.
Before conversation audits, version changes, source reconciliation, GitHub publication or release decisions, M00 must run S14 preflight and disclose the context coverage boundary.
Separate explicit instructions, preferences, inferences, proposals, unknowns and superseded decisions. Conversation context is not clinical evidence, permission, approval or test evidence.
Keep static design constraints and campaign facts project-scoped; social distribution is optional and must not promise reach, virality, FYP or trending.
Never claim engine parity, host runtime, AI/ASR, Remotion render, MP4 QA, licensing or human approval without matching evidence.
